Efforts to target signaling pathways in fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma

Cellular signaling pathways that have or are being evaluated as targetable in FP-RMS include those active at the plasma membrane, including RTKs and downstream signaling members, organic cation transporters (OCTs) that facilitate metformin transport, and developmental pathway receptors for TGF-beta, Smoothened, Notch, and Wnt. In principle, PAX3::FOXO1 activity itself can be modified by targeting epigenetic modifiers, transcriptional inhibitors, enzymes that impact PAX3::FOXO1 post-translational modifications, or DNA damage/repair pathways. Finally, PAX3::FOXO1 mRNA or protein could in principle be directly targeted for degradation by siRNAs/ASOs or PROTACs/bioPROTACs, respectively. Transcriptional targets of PAX3::FOXO1 can also be targeted, although to date they have not shown durable activity. Created in BioRender. Turco, G. (2025) https://BioRender.com/ty4sufs
